Monoclonal antibodies are increasingly transported across the placenta as pregnancy progresses, with the largest amount transferred during the third trimester. Therefore, efgartigimod alfa may be transmitted from the mother to the developing fetus. As VYVGART HYTRULO is expected to reduce maternal IgG antibody levels, reduction in passive protection to the newborn is anticipated.

postpartum.value: If exposed in the third trimester, evaluate neonatal serum IgG concentrations after birth and consider delaying live infant vaccines until maternal antibody protection/immune status is confirmed.
